explanation: P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B). Since independent, P(A and B) = P(A)*P(B) = 0.3 * 0.4 = 0.12. P(A U B) = 0.3 + 0.4 - 0.12 = 0.58.
All options represent standard correct algebraic properties of variance for independent variables.
For a Poisson distribution, both mean and variance are equal to the parameter lambda. Hence, Variance = 5.
